claims.statement: For every r>=2, the negative point-defect block N_r satisfies U(N_r)<=16 I(N_r)/9.
claims.evidence: PROOF.md Section 1; CHECK.py checks ranks 2 through 40 diagnostically

claims.statement: If U(P)<=16I(P)/9, every fresh fair-selector tower with arbitrary negative point-defect ranks r_k>=2 satisfies U(F_d)<=16I(F_d)/9 for every finite depth.
claims.quantifiers: all base dimensions, Boolean bases satisfying the endpoint, all finite depths, and all rank sequences r_k>=2
claims.evidence: PROOF.md Sections 2-3; CHECK.py direct and recurrence checks

claims.statement: Every finite adaptive/pruned physical restriction tree on such a tower, with any common disjoint Boolean terminal core, has signed retained U loss at most 16I(F_d)/9.
claims.quantifiers: all permitted finite trees, rank sequences, reveal orders, pruning policies, and common disjoint terminal cores
claims.evidence: PROOF.md Section 4; CHECK.py pruned-tree and terminal-cancellation checks

scope_correction: The retained theorem is an endpoint signed telescope; it does not establish first-revelation or single-use credit ownership.
unaffected_open_claim: No dimension-independent retained-credit theorem is proved for biased outer selectors, variable reuse, or changing/overlapping/leaf-dependent coherent cores.
